layout: Reference-inspired side-by-side living room and bedroom, compact bathroom on left, curved hull.
prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a revised single-occupant TNG crew quarters map closely based on the supplied cutaway architectural reference, translating its spatial arrangement and furnishings into a strict flat 90-degree OVERHEAD battlemap. User wants rooms more like this reference rather than previous generic tall rectangle with bedroom and bathroom across top. ONE wide landscape cabin on black void, ceiling removed. THREE rooms: compact enclosed bathroom at far LEFT near the entrance vestibule; generously sized central LIVING ROOM with external entry door on its upper/left wall; separate BEDROOM at RIGHT with one bed against upper wall. Living room and bedroom side by side, not stacked. Warm cream wall panels, dusty burgundy/rose carpeting, soft sage/taupe trim and golden tan bedding like reference. Gently curved outer hull boundary along lower edge with flush narrow window-wall segments. Translate reference's thick sloping sculptural divider frames to THIN flat sage-grey partition cross-sections separating bedroom from living area; include a generous usable sliding doorway in divider, open to show connection but each room visibly bounded. No upright diagonal beams drawn across floor. Bathroom enclosed at left with doorway from living/entry area, includes compact basin, toilet and dry sonic shower (no water shower head or tub). Entry door clearly present and connected directly to living room. Furnish living room like reference: one sculpted tan lounge chair, small round walnut/glass side table, one potted leafy plant, restrained small decorative object on table, and a slim fitted desk with usable task chair along left/service wall if space allows. Bedroom has a single golden ochre bed, small bedside surface and fitted storage; not a giant bed filling entire room. Keep furnishings sparse and comfortable with generous clear paths. One continuous muted warm rose carpet across bedroom and living room, light warm-grey carpet border following walls; pale nonslip bathroom floor. ALL walls thin and flat as overhead wall caps, no tall elevation faces, chunky 3D ribs or hanging lamps; only furniture has subtle depth/contact shading. No arc lights or vertical wall-mounted lights depicted from above. No ceiling, perspective, isometric view, labels, text, logos, grid, watermark, people, collage or reference credit. Prioritize reference-like side-by-side room arrangement, curved hull and domestic TNG materials. Render the entire cabin and all three room connections clearly.

Correct this cabin render's camera and wall treatment ONLY while retaining its exact three-room side-by-side floor plan, curved lower hull, furniture positions, warm rose carpet, cream/golden palette, window positions and black exterior. Convert it to TRUE straight-down orthographic 90 degree overhead flat 2D battlemap. All floor edges parallel to map axes where straight, no perspective foreshortening. REMOVE every visible tall vertical wall face and exterior hull elevation, including upper cream panels, deep white hull fascia, upright entry door elevation and tall centre partition. Replace all architecture with slim flat overhead wall cross-sections, about 15 pixels wide on a 1600 pixel image, warm taupe caps and very subtle edge shadow only. Window glazing becomes narrow flush dark-blue line within slim curved wall cap, no upright glass. Entry door becomes thin flat sliding-door cross-section in upper living wall, partially open. Both interior doorway connections remain clear and readable, with no vertical door elevation or beam across floor. Furnishings viewed from DIRECTLY ABOVE: bed rectangular with pillow above, wardrobe flat walnut top, chairs seat/back tops, table round, toilet bowl top, sonic shower dry booth top without water hardware. Preserve same floor footprint and generous living room left, bedroom right, bathroom far left. Exterior empty space black, no wide white hull band. The result must match a flat overhead tabletop map, not a tilted cutaway or dollhouse. No labels, people, text or grid.
